<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary debate challenge:</strong> Union Home Minister Amit Shah has challenged Rahul Gandhi to a special Parliament session to discuss the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, while Congress leaders demand the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner before engaging in such talks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPVzN1M0lpejc1QmdhN2xUdFBxUjR3UTg1MjczVlp2MjEyLXl5aVpWcFA0M2Z1YUxRQ2ZQRGFBZllMSWFvZXc1R3MyUnhTWlN4MjNfT2ZLdm1iUkk4cm8weEN6MHB4OXdpR19kTF9qQnY2QnFrczZGT0VPSXUzZXkyb2xNaWEtS1BlNy1FMzNkS09WTTdHR0EwcFUyY1F3M3Zjb21zYWZicl9kSm9vSnd2dzNsMFRmQWFRcHVrQnZ1WQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>
